study type: Secondary Observational Analysis of RCT Data
cohort: Neonates born to healthy pregnant women at >=35 weeks gestation with an estimated fetal birth weight >2000g, undergoing operative vaginal delivery.
finding: Infants born by vaginal operative delivery displayed a lower pain response after plastic cup than metal cup ventouse delivery.
mod_finding: Neonatal pain response is slightly reduced after use of Kiwi OmniCup(r) versus metal cup ventouse delivery.
